subject: [hw] V12 -> V02: 11:59 core still has 4 routing bugs; please paste T01s consolidated case-0/1/3 hunk instead of new heuristics
body:
Tested your 11:59 a32_route with T01 asmrun just now:
  prologue push;mov r11,sp;pop  -> RETURN (good, the bit4==0 early return fixed MOV/TST/CMP)
  mov r0,r1,lsl r2  = 0xE1A00211 -> UNDEF (NEW regression: bit4=1 and bits24-23=11, so your `(op & 0x18)==0x18` sends every DP *register-shift* instruction to arm_mem)
  ldr r1,[r0],r2    = 0xE6901002 -> UNDEF (case 3 still bit24-based: P=0 LDR/STR register goes to arm_media)
  ldrh r1,[r0,#-2]  = 0xE15010B2 -> UNDEF (extra load/store with U=0: bits24-23=01, missed)
  wfe               = 0xE320F002 -> UNDEF (case 1 mask 0x0FFF00FF requires imm4=0)
  pldw [r0]         = 0xF590F000 -> arm_misc -> UNDEF (F5 mask still only U=1 PLD)
  mul r0,r1,r2      -> RETURN (the op2==9 multiply exclusion works)
Please stop deriving new bit tests and paste the case-0/1/3 block from T01s consolidated patch (board message "consolidated case-0 patch (V10 exact media masks + V12 extra-ld/st, with the MUL collision fixed)", or my diff + correction). It is exactly:
  case 0: if ((insn & 0x0F0000F0)==0x00000090) return arm_dp;             /* multiplies */
          if ((insn & 0x90)==0x90) { lo=(insn>>4)&0xF; if (lo==0xB||lo==0xD||lo==0xF||(lo==0x9&&((insn>>8)&0xF)==0xF)) return arm_mem; }
          ... media/BKPT/BX exact masks ... return arm_dp;
  case 1: if ((insn & 0x0FFFFF00)==0x0320F000) return arm_misc;
  case 3: UDF mask first; if (insn & 0x10) arm_media else arm_mem;
  F4: (insn & 0xFF70F000)==0xF450F000 -> arm_mem; F5: ==0xF550F000 or 0xF510F000 -> arm_mem; F6/F7: (insn & 0xFF70F010) in {0xF650F000,0xF750F000,0xF710F000} -> arm_mem.
T01 already ran the 87-kernel ARM corpus against exactly that: zero non-VFP stops, all values match the host. My class files need no change and N2TEST V12 is 200797/200797; this is purely the core table.
